text:
Tomas Hertl scored twice on the power play in Pittsburgh on Nov. 4, the second with 30 seconds left to beat the Penguins, and that game is a good summary of his season. Six of his 12 points have come on the power play. He has 7 goals in 18 games on 7.39 expected goals, so his finishing is right where it should be.

At 5v5 he has been even better than the points suggest. Vegas takes 63.4 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, nearly 12 points better than without him. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him in the 84th percentile among forwards for setting up shots, though he rarely carries the puck in himself.

The quiet concern is the ice time, down more than a minute a night over his last ten games, at 14:53. At 32 that may be the coaches managing his load. Our range has him around 26 goals this season. If he keeps winning his minutes like this, he will get them back.
headline: Hertl does his best work with the extra man
